notes.title: Major Habroxia 2 Update
notes.content:
A new major update is out adding many features, improvements and fixes to Habroxia 2.
Major highlights are:
-New Arcade Mode that has Online Leaderboard Functionality
-New Arcade Style Controls Options
-Support for Keyboard
-Controller Detection for DualShock 4, DualSense, Xbox One controller, Xbox Series X/S controller, Xbox 360 controller, Switch Pro controller, Steam Deck and more.
-New Achievements
-Many fixes and adjustments

notes.title: Habroxia 2 - New Challenges Update
notes.content:
With today's update we have added a number of things to Habroxia 2. The theme of this update is new challenges. 
-We have added loads of brutal new achievements to the game that will challenge the best of players. 
-We have redone the way boost-rush mode progresses, and added a new level to it.
-There are new upgrades in the shop to max out your ship even further.
-A number of bugs have been fixed up.
-Steam Cloud saves are now supported.
-Full Screen / Windowed Mode and Window resizing is now supported.

Thanks for playing Habroxia 2, we hope that you enjoy the new content.

notes.title: Habroxia 2 Big Update
notes.content:
Improved performance and boot time.
Smoother player movement.
Fixes to amplified sounds.
Debris added to Boost Rush Mode.
Boost Rush Mode Level 2 added.
New hidden path and secret Boss.
Enemy Compendium added.
More enemies added to NG+ mode.
NG++ mode added.
Unlockable Journal Entries added.
Boss E (SKULD) lead up added.
Tweaking to boss patterns, difficulty and animation.
Tweaking to enemy behaviors, difficulty, animation and locations.
Boost recharge added, with additional boost rewarded when boosting through enemies.
Tweaking to pickups drop rates to increase currency pickups and reduce boost pickups.
Tweaking and balancing to special weapons.
New menus system.
New GUI for the map.
Added ability to restart levels.
Added ability to start levels with or without changing special weapon load-out.
High Scores now displayed on map.
New art for the map screen.
New environments added.
New design for the Advanced Arc Fighter.
Fixes to the transitions to hidden paths.
Fix to ensure shields carry over to hidden paths.
New options for the aiming line.
Option to turn voiced audio for pickups on or off.
Changes to Boss Rush Mode.
Updated Credits with additional names.
Additional Ship Upgrades added.
Additional Steam Achievements added.
